decisions.reason: ACE3 is central to the firm's core ALCMS lighting expertise, where in-house R&D and long operational experience let it interpret field results and keep improving the product.

The air situation display draws on the firm's tower and integration know-how and fits its integrated real-time operations strategy, though its lower visibility makes it somewhat more exposed to being folded into other offers.
Airport systems training builds directly on the firm's installed base and operational knowledge, and it adds to service revenue and customer learning at low cost.
Airfield ground lighting training draws on the firm's core lighting expertise, although as a narrower course it could be merged into the broader training program.
The collaboration software supports the firm's direction toward collaborative decision-making and data integration, and its systems know-how lets it learn from early deployments.
The MLAT flagship extends the firm's surveillance and tower capabilities, which its R&D and integration experience can absorb, so it is a strategic focus worth developing further.
